# Definitions stay resolvable but cannot enter AD 1 gameplay.
take_over_loan =  {
	category = CATEGORY_ECONOMY_ACTIONS
	type = diplomacy
	is_take_over_loan = yes

	potential = {
		always = no # ANTIQVITAS mounted-system quarantine
	}

	ai_tick = monthly
	ai_tick_frequency = 6

	allow = {
	}

	select_trigger = {
		looking_for_a = country
		target_flag = recipient
		name = "choose_country"
		column = {
			data = name
		}
		visible = {
			num_loans > 0
		}
        enabled = {
			any_loan = {
				is_bond = no
				NOT = { exists = owner }
				months_left > 40
				loan_interest > scope:actor.modifier:bank_interest
				scope:actor.gold > remaining_debt
			}
		}
	}

	effect = {
		scope:recipient = {
			ordered_loan = {
				limit = {
					is_bond = no
					NOT = { exists = owner }
					months_left > 40
					loan_interest > scope:actor.modifier:bank_interest
					scope:actor.gold > remaining_debt
				}
				order_by = remaining_debt
				max = 1

				custom_description = {
					text = pay_off_their_debt
					value = bank_loan_takeover_cost
					scope:actor = {
						add_gold = {
							value = prev.bank_loan_takeover_cost
							multiply = -1
						}
					}
					scope:recipient = {
						distribute_gold_to_banking_estates = prev.bank_loan_takeover_cost
					}
				}

				change_loan_owner = scope:actor
			}
		}
	}

	ai_will_do = {
		#Ignore smaller countries for performance
		add = -20
		add = scope:recipient.country_tax_base
	}
}
